gameDescriptionHtml:
Welcome to Miami, the city of sun, sand, and neon lights! In Miami Hotel Simulator, you and your friends team up to renovate, manage, and grow your very own hotel. Work together in multiplayer mode to clean rooms, serve guests, and keep your customers happy.

You’ve just bought an old hotel in the heart of Miami. Your job? Turn it into a luxurious retreat that brings in big profits. Upgrade the hotel, manage guest services, and watch as visitors spend on your slot machines, restaurants, and bars, fueling your success.

But it’s not all sunshine – more guests mean more mess. You’ll have to deal with garbage, clogged toilets, and messy rooms before new guests can check in. The more you manage, the more you can profit and customize your hotel, creating a space that reflects your style.

Jump into Miami Hotel Simulator and turn your hotel into a paradise in the city of neon!

Game Features

  • Multiplayer: Manage the hotel with your friends, delegate tasks, and work as a team.
  • Hotel Customization: Design and upgrade every part of your hotel to attract more guests and maximize profits.
  • Hireable Staff & Automation: As your hotel grows, hire staff like cleaners, receptionists, and chefs to handle tasks automatically. With the right team, your hotel can practically run itself!
  • Open World Exploration: Step outside your hotel and explore the lively streets of Miami. Shop for decor and upgrades, sell unwanted items at the pawn shop, or buy your dream car. Cruise around solo or with friends, uncover hidden items, and enjoy the neon-soaked city at your own pace.
  • Souvenir Shop: Boost your profits by selling souvenirs to your guests! Stock your shop with Miami-themed items and customize the layout. A well-managed souvenir shop adds style and revenue to your hotel business.
